headline: Tecnotree Raises Guidance on Margin Expansion in Q3 Results
summary: Digital platform provider Tecnotree upgraded its full-year guidance following margin expansion in its third-quarter financial results.
why: Tecnotree supplies digital business support systems and telecom software across emerging markets in the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America.

impacts.name: Tecnotree Oyj
impacts.why: Upgraded full-year guidance signals improving operating leverage and cash generation.
